channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerami Grant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerami Grant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brandon Miller on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Brandon Miller:

“He saved me. (Jerami Grant) got by me, winning play by Kon. That’s all we ask for is just everybody make all the winning plays, and Kon was in the position to make a play. So just having that mindset of being a winner in Kon, I think that’s kinda what separates him from all the other rookies.”

Brandon Miller on Jerami Grant, Mar 11, 2026. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant:

“I do think he's underappreciated. Mainly because we just haven't won. If you're not a Blazers fan, you don't see him. We're never on national TV. So he does go under the radar. But the people that know, really know.”

Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant, Oct 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant, Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups:

“Everything I believe in as a coach is what [Grant and Thybulle] embody. They take coaching, they can both be good on the offensive side and the defensive side of the ball.”

Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant, Matisse Thybulle, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Damian Lillard on Jerami Grant's All-Star chances:

“There's so many really good players in the league that it's hard to be an All-Star. Whether he actually makes the All-Star team or not, he's that caliber of a player. We definitely got that guy we were looking for.”

Damian Lillard on Jerami Grant, Nov 15, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant
item.description:
#PistonsTroy Weaver on Jerami Grant being extension-eligible:

“Jerami demonstrated his efficiency in the way he fit with the group...people had their feelers out at the deadline (for a trade), but nothing really blew us away.”

Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant, Apr 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Casey:

“You don't generate some of the things Jerami brings. You have to do it in a different way. ... Our thing is playing organized.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Dec 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Rod Beard:Draymond Green on #Pistons Jerami Grant:

“He's one of the guys in the NBA...What he's gone (to Detroit) and done is incredible. He's one of the most improved players in this league, for sure.”

Draymond Green on Jerami Grant, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Team USA coachGregg Popovich on #Pistons Jerami Grant:

“I wanted him on this team because of his size and length, flexibility and versatility that he will give us, and the fact that he's a competitor.”

Gregg Popovich on Jerami Grant, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant:

“You get to know him as a person, he's a genuine, humble and hungry person. He wants to be one of the best in the league. He's more and then some in terms of what I expected as a scorer. I know he's not a finished product.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Apr 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on facing Jerami Grant/Mason Plumlee:

“That team from last year... I'm going to remember those guys for the rest of my life. We made history. We did something nobody’s ever done before, coming back from 3-1 two times. We didn’t quit. I really appreciate all of them.”

Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Will Barton on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Nuggets forward Will Barton added:

“(Grant) was one of the guys I was really close to on that team. We just talked to each other and showed love for each other. That’s all.”

Will Barton on Jerami Grant, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant's All-Star bid:

“He will be an All-Star, either this year or in the future. I'm going to campaign my butt off to make that happen.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Feb 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on whether he'll lobby other coaches for Jerami Grant to be an All-Star:

“I will. I've always done thatand I have a good relationship with a lot of coaches around the league to make sure appreciate what Jerami has done.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant's case to be an All-Star, placing in the top 10 in the first returns:

“I hope our record doesn't hurt him in any way. He deserves it from a talent standpoint.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Feb 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, ahead of tomorrow's game in Denver:

“I think the entire league knows he's a prime candidate for Most Improved, for the All-Star team.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on whether they wait a few possessions to run plays for Jerami Grant early:

“Jerami's going to get his; we run a lot of things for him.”

Dwane Casey on Jerami Grant, Jan 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant's success:

“Belief is the first step of success...he believed in me and I believed in him.”

Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant
item.description:
#Pistons Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant's start to the season:

“I expect him to continue to progress and get better as well. I'm excited that he took a chance on himself and on the Pistons as well. I'm not surprised at all.”

Troy Weaver on Jerami Grant, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig
item.description:
Katy Winge:Coach Malone on possibly becoming a more offensive-minded team with the loss of Plumlee, Grant, & Craig:

“I’m all about offense now baby! We’re going to score 130 a night.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Paul Millsap on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Michael Singer:Paul Millsap on Jerami Grant:

“I'm always on the side of whatever a player decides what's best for them. I can't sit here and say I know what's best for Jerami or anybody else can sit here and say they know what's best for Jerami.”

Paul Millsap on Jerami Grant, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Barton:

“You can look at it both ways. ... There's certain things that Will Barton brings to our team that other guys just can't do. ... Also allowed us to take a look at Jerami Grant as our starting SF.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jerami Grant, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Mirotic, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Malone:

“We have three games to go. How we're going to approach those games is try to get in a rhythm, monitor their minutes, Jamal, Michael, Nikola, Jerami have all played an extremely high amount of minutes This game is an opportunity for us to compete and get better....”

Michael Malone on Nikola Mirotic, Jerami Grant, Aug 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Harvey Grant on Jerami Grant
item.description:
“I’m going hard. Next thing I know, I’m playing Jerami, he just went by me like I was standing there. I’m like, ‘Oh shucks, like, OK.’ Of course the competitiveness came out in me. I’m trying to put my forearm on him. Man, after that, I’m like, ‘I’m done.’”

Harvey Grant on Jerami Grant, Jun 21, 2020. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone said after a training camp practice.

“Jerami’s versatility, his athleticism, his length, and I know I said it yesterday, but his ability to get off the floor quickly is remarkable. He is a rim protector. He's a shot blocker. I think he understands, in Oklahoma City they played really good defense. So, Jerami understands what helps you win games. He understands that that's a big part of our identity here in Denver. And he's all in.”

Michael Malone on Jerami Grant, Oct 13, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jerami Grant
item.description:
Chris Dempsey:Malone on Grant:

“I think he’s going to fit seamlessly into our culture. And he’s a guy who was a starter on a playoff team.”

Michael Malone on Jerami Grant, Jul 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jerami Grant
item.description:
#Nuggets coachMichael Malone on the Jerami Grant trade:

“I think the Denver Nuggets got a lot better. ... He’s a guy that I’ve long thought very, very highly of.”

Michael Malone on Jerami Grant, Jul 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Hamidou Diallo on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant
item.description:
“I have Russell Westbrook, Paul George, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant, guys that have been playing in the league for so long. Hopefully, one of those guys will take me under their wing,and I’ll get to know what they did their rookie year that made them end up where they are now. A guy like Russell Westbrook, for him to take me under his wing and just be able to teach me the ropes and be able to teach me what he did his rookie year is a blessing.”

Hamidou Diallo on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant, Jul 13, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Sam Presti on Jerami Grant
item.description:
“We are thrilled to have Jerami continue his development and career with the Thunder,”

Sam Presti on Jerami Grant, Jul 7, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Jerami Grant
item.description:
“Ersan will bring us much needed perimeter shooting, floor spacing and roster balance, while the acquisition of a future pick or picks should continue to drive our ability to generate future roster building options. On behalf of the entire organization, I want to thank Jerami for his valuable contributions to our team and for always being the respectable and classy professional that he is.”

Bryan Colangelo on Jerami Grant, Nov 1, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Jerami Grant
item.description:
“They’ve expressed an interest in Jerami Grant over the course of time. The offers continued to get richer and richer. This led to the right timing from our perspective when the offer became realistic for us to make a move with Jerami, who we viewed as a nice young piece here.”

Bryan Colangelo on Jerami Grant, Nov 1, 2016. Source: CSNPhilly.com.
